finding: Concurrent stage writers could both download and later register overlapping digests, leaving a gap between the shared download phase and exclusive ownership registration where a different registered writer could make those files pruneable. The failure was closed, but avoidable.
resolution: An independent per-policy sync mutex is acquired before any cache lock and remains held across stage discovery, download, exclusive ownership registration and inspection. Stage refresh does not enter sync while holding a cache lock; shared readers and exclusive pruners retain their existing lock hierarchy.
scope: This closes R6 in refresh-component-review.json at these source hashes. Final integrated suites/source commit and real stage execution remain pending.
